_source: Zeus.exe (GOG). See docs/logic/religion.md. All tables verified from code/data unless the field name ends in _hyp.

_fields.id: god id = index of the god record (0x00EF5DD8 + 52*id), +0x14
_fields.sanctuary_type: BUILD_* type, god_sanctuary_type 0x004E8B40 (Poseidon in a Poseidon game: 98 = BUILD_LARGE_SANC_POSEIDON2)
_fields.help_threshold: FUN_004E6040: help/prayer allowed while god.prayer_counter (+0x0C) <= this
_fields.help_cost_auto: FUN_004E60B0(flag=0): added to +0x0C by an automatic blessing
_fields.help_cost_prayer: FUN_004E60B0(flag=1): added to +0x0C by a prayer (granted or queued)
_fields.power: FUN_004EE710: god-vs-god fight rank (higher wins unless a special rule applies)
_fields.curse_months_by_difficulty: 0x0063AEAC[id*5 + difficulty]; curse length in months (stored <<4 in month_advance calls)
_fields.curse_types: building types a visiting god blesses / an attacking god curses (FUN_004E9310 -> per-god predicates)
_fields.visit_bless_chance: FUN_004E9290: percent numerator; chance = this / building_size (0x005F6368[type*32])
_fields.monster: FUN_00586C90: the god's monster when the god is an unfriendly god of the scenario
_fields.good_monster: FUN_00586D50: monster that serves the city when the god's sanctuary is active
_fields.oracle: FUN_004EA630: oracle counter +0x10 costs/threshold (Zeus, Apollo only)
